method: Argon via the user-authorized agy CLI, direct native read_file audio ingestion. Local ffprobe durations and checksums are authoritative; early perceptual time estimates were inconsistent and were not used as exact edit instructions.

cannon-report.evidence: Final edited sample was directly re-listened: one immediate sharp outdoor blast, low-mid body and crisp crack, clean smooth fade, no second hit.

cannon-recoil.evidence: Wooden carriage rolls and scrapes, taut breeching creak and solid wooden arrest, no gun blast or modern machinery.

cannon-rammer.evidence: Edited opening directly re-listened: single scraping/sliding motion and muffled seating thud; no later rhythmic taps.

cannon-run-out.evidence: Restrained timber and rope strain, short low rolling shift and quiet settling, no crash or voices.

captain-guns-prepare.heard: Hands to the guns! Load round shot!
captain-guns-prepare.evidence: Replacement ends cleanly and matches accepted Captain Trevenen voice.

rejected.cannon-report-01: Low cinematic thud without sharp attack.

caution: Perceptual model review is a quality gate, not a recording of an actual period naval gun or a human approval of the finished game mix. Final mix still requires user listening.
